activity.notes: Mozart settled in Vienna in 1781 and spent the final decade of his composing career there until his death in 1791. ATLAS uses the Viennese 1781-1791 artistic phase under the Habsburg Monarchy rather than his entire life across Salzburg and extensive travel.

sources.title: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart — International Mozarteum Foundation
sources.citation_text: The Mozarteum's biographical chronology covers Mozart's move into the independent Viennese career in 1781 and his death in Vienna in 1791.
